name: Antalya
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the Antalya metropolitan area on Turkey's Mediterranean coast (Turkiye), from Konyaalti to the airport and Kundu hotel district. 142,100+ OSM buildings, 841,000+ commuters built from TUIK population data by district with jobs estimated from OpenStreetMap commercial density. Special demand points: Antalya Airport (AYT) with separate international and domestic terminals (real 2025 traffic, 39M+ passengers/year), Akdeniz University, and two major hospitals (Antalya City Hospital, Antalya Training & Research Hospital). Simulated traffic congestion on longer commutes.
